reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin for switching character skins and interactively arranging character and sticker assets with upload, local persistence, and shareable layout packs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色皮肤切换、图片素材上传以及可拖动缩放旋转的装饰看板编辑功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin for switching character skins, uploading image assets, and editing decorative boards with draggable, scalable, and rotatable elements.

capabilities: edits positions, scale, rotation, opacity, and anchoring of visual assets
uploads user-selected images as characters or stickers
exports and imports JSON decoration packs containing assets and layouts
stores skin selection and decoration settings in localStorage
